Questions

Before you climb up there yourself…

How much does a roof restoration cost in Newcastle?

It depends on roof size, pitch and condition. Most Newcastle restorations fall in a broad mid-range well below a full replacement, and we’ll give you one fixed written price after a free inspection — so you can compare properly, with no pressure to decide on the day.

How long does a restoration or re-roof take?

A standard restoration takes 2–3 days (weather permitting). A full tile-to-Colorbond® replacement on an average home usually takes 3–5 days. We’ll confirm timing in your quote and keep you updated daily.

What happens at the free inspection?

We get on the roof and check tiles, bedding, flashings and gutters, take photos of anything that needs attention, and talk you through what we find. Then you get one fixed price in writing — and the decision is entirely yours.

I have a leak — what should I do?

If you’ve got an active leak, call us on (02) 8550 1180 and tell us what’s happening. We’ll talk through what you can do straight away and arrange a visit to find the source.

Tile or Colorbond® — which is better?

Both can be excellent. Tile suits classic Newcastle homes and can be restored very cost-effectively. Colorbond® is lighter, quieter in heavy rain than many expect, and needs less maintenance. We’ll show you both options with honest pros, cons and prices.

Is the inspection really free?

Yes — inspection, photos and written quote are free and obligation-free for homeowners in our service area. If you need a formal pre-purchase or insurance report, we’ll quote that separately upfront.
